appDescription.message: Record video and audio actually played on the current page. Use only with content you have the right to save.

legalPointRights.message: Record only content you have the right to save, such as your own, licensed, or public-domain material.

legalPointCompliance.message: Follow copyright laws and website terms. Unauthorized recording, saving, or distribution may be illegal.
